expected.analysis: Exploratory individual-model combined raw-gain Welch TOST; twelve exact AI identities tested in both sections; same140human observations for each; fixed original pooled margin; not section-adjusted or clustered.
expected.cost_definition: Mean available estimated inference cost divided by mean observed gain, not causal incremental gain; human reference divided by observed human mean gain.
expected.cost_limit: Includes reconstructed and incomplete billing; inference only versus human session price; no all-in savings claim.

combined.interpretation: descriptive arm-level association, not a causal latency test
combined.x_metric: log10 arm median tutor reply latency (seconds)

quant.interpretation: descriptive arm-level association, not a causal latency test
quant.x_metric: log10 arm median tutor reply latency (seconds)

verbal.interpretation: descriptive arm-level association, not a causal latency test
verbal.x_metric: log10 arm median tutor reply latency (seconds)

latency_student_engagement.definition: Each point is one AI arm. X is the arm median of student-level median AI reply latency; Y is the equal-student mean count of nonblank free-form messages authored by the human student.

multiplicity.family: Pearson and Spearman latency-engagement associations across Quant, Verbal, and Combined

interaction_fingerprint.combined_rule: student-weighted pooling of the 12 exact AI arm IDs fielded in both sections
interaction_fingerprint.interpretation: Interaction fingerprints describe session process, not a composite quality score. Message and practice-volume leaders are not necessarily learning leaders; practice accuracy is conditional on model-selected problems.

multiplicity.omnibus_family: seven process metrics across Quant, Verbal, and Combined
multiplicity.omnibus_method: Holm family-wise error correction across 21 tests
multiplicity.pairwise_method: Holm correction separately within each metric-by-scope panel
